function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data as specified by the parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent. It is expected to be a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: The Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request. Each key-value pair represents a header name and its value.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float, or a (connect_timeout, read_timeout) tuple. This is a float type value.

lat.description: Latitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

lon.description: Longitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL for the GET request.

allow_redirects.description: Determines if HTTP redirections (301, 302, etc.) should be followed.

auth.description: A tuple representing the user credentials for HTTP authentication, typically in the form of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to an SSL certificate file to verify the peer, or a tuple of (certificate file, key file).

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request. The key is the cookie name and the value is the cookie value.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be downloaded immediately but streamed.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not, or a path to a CA bundle if verification is needed.

message.content:
Sure thing! The best place to order a cake depends a bit on where you’re located and what kind of cake you’re after (custom design, quick pick‑up, or something delivered right to your door). If you let me know your city or zip code, I can give you a list of local bakeries and delivery services that are highly rated in your area. In the meantime, here’s a quick rundown of the most common options:

| Option | What it offers | How to order | Pros | Cons |
|--------|----------------|--------------|------|------|
| **Local specialty bakeries** | Custom cakes, seasonal flavors, artisanal designs | Phone, website, or in‑person | Personal touch, often unique flavors | May have limited delivery hours |
| **National cake‑delivery sites** (e.g., Goldbelly, Cake Delivery, BakeShop) | Curated selection from top U.S. bakeries | Online order, choose pickup or delivery | Wide variety, nationwide reach | Shipping can be pricey; delivery times vary |
| **Grocery store chains** (Walmart, Kroger, Safeway, Publix) | Ready‑made cakes, some custom options | In‑store or online (via their website/app) | Convenient, often cheaper | Limited customization |
| **Food‑delivery apps** (Uber Eats, DoorDash, Postmates, Grubhub) | Cakes from local bakeries or grocery stores | App order | Fast delivery, easy tracking | Delivery fees, limited selection |
| **Online marketplaces** (Etsy, Amazon Handmade) | Handmade, custom cakes from independent bakers | Online order | Unique, often handmade | Shipping delays, higher cost |
| **Specialty dessert shops** (Tart shops, cupcake boutiques) | Gourmet desserts, often with cake options | Phone or website | Creative flavors, high quality | Usually no delivery outside the city |

### Quick Tips for Ordering a Cake

1. **Check Reviews & Ratings** – Look at recent customer photos and comments to gauge quality.
2. **Ask About Delivery Times** – Make sure the cake arrives fresh and on schedule.
3. **Confirm Customization Options** – If you want a specific design or flavor, confirm it’s possible.
4. **Know the Return/Refund Policy** – Especially for online orders, in case something goes wrong.
5. **Consider the Occasion** – Some bakeries specialize in birthdays, weddings, or corporate events.

---

#### Want a tailored list?

If you tell me your city or zip code, I can pull up a few top‑rated bakeries and delivery services in your area, along with their contact info and any special deals they might have right now. Just let me know!
